Ever since my dog, Rex, was a puppy, he’s had a sensitive tummy. With frequent bouts of gas, bloating, and loose poop, our quest to find the perfect diet for him felt never-ending.

Even when we switched him to one of the most highly recommended raw diets, we still found ourselves at the vet every few months for anal gland expression. If we didn’t, he’d start scooting across the carpet or constantly licking his back end.

When spring came around, things got even stranger — Rex started grazing on grass all the time and occasionally going for… let’s just say very questionable snacks 😬

We tried everything — bran, oats, even Greek yoghurt — but nothing really worked. Eventually, our vet suggested adding a pre & probiotic blend to his diet. The alternative was surgery to remove his anal glands, which we really wanted to avoid.

After doing some research, we decided to try a probiotic chew supplement.

We’ve been using them for just over two weeks now, and honestly — the difference has been huge. Rex barely grazes on grass anymore, his stools are firm, and the gas has settled down massively.

The scooting? Almost completely gone.

Best part — he actually loves the taste, so it’s not a battle to give them to him every day.

It’s such a relief seeing him comfortable, happy, and back to himself again.
Designed to keep everything organised (treats, keys, poop bags… the essentials) without compromising your outfit.

But there's a catch. Fibre DIVERSITY matters.

Why? Because there are 100's of different species of bacteria living in your gut and they thrive on different types of fibre.

So unfortunately 2 cups of lentils doesn't cut it.

And that's not all. CONSISTENCY is key.

You need 30 grams of diverse fibre every single day, all year round (at the very least, really you want 40 grams plus). 

We're big advocates for getting your fibre intake from your regular diet when possible, but as you can see, that's really hard to do.

And what we're talking about here is vitally important, it affects how every system in your body performs. Fibre fuels your gut, your gut fuels everything from your skin to your mood to your cognitive function.

But don’t stress.

myota contains a powerful blend of fibres that specifically feed the good bacteria in your gut - the ones that deliver on the key health benefits we're looking for.

61% improvement in insulin sensitivity

We're proud to say that with just one scoop a day and consistent use, myota is clinically proven to improve digestion and boost your overall health. 

While long term use will see positive effects on your heart, immune & cognitive function.

This all results from fibre and a flourishing gut microbiome.

Future you will look back on this as a turning point. The time you chose to transform the system that powers your health.

What if you don't see early results? myota was developed over 10 years of research at MIT so we're pretty confident you will, but if not, let us know within 30 days of your purchase and we’ll give you a full refund. No questions asked.
